title: Gloria (Manchicourt, Missa Quo abiit dilectus tuus)
desc: Pierre de Manchicourt, Missa Quo abiit dilectus tuus, Gloria, 1556. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0013_2); edited by Vincent Besson, Marco Gurrieri, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
